_what: MOVE-ASIDE manifest for the chain-rebuild proof on aug06/set-01 (ledger chain_rebuild_proof_aug06_set01). run_set_chain.sh SKIPS a stage whose product exists (:290 'stack exists -> skip build', :299 'judge surface exists -> skip finish'), so a rebuild is not non-destructive by default. These four accepted products are MOVED, not deleted, so the rebuild can be compared against them and NOTHING ACCEPTED IS OVERWRITTEN. Each entry carries bytes, mtime, the head+tail sha256[:32] (baseline_guard._sha's form) and a FULL sha256 -- the full hash is what makes the pixel-identity prediction P1 exact rather than sampled.
rule: the four products run_set_chain.sh sessions/aug06 set-01 owns for route undistort-groups: STACK=$RESULTS/stack_${SET}_full.fit (:214) with its _wcs and _spcc siblings, and the judge surface finish_render.sh writes as <name>_spcc-linked.png. Group sub-stacks and masters are NOT moved -- the owner ruled scope option 1 (preflight + compose), so run_undistort_groups.sh:317 resumes on the five existing sub-stacks.
precedent: datasets/corpus/spcc_pin_zf/moveaside_manifest.json (44 files, identities recorded, later disposed under the manifest)
verification: every source absent and every target present; FULL sha256 and bytes identical before and after the move (asserted in the same pass that moved them)
disposition: DISPOSED — owner-directed. The four copies are deleted; their identities stay in `moves` below so anyone can still verify exactly what was removed. Nothing else was touched.

disposed.checked_before_rm: each file confirmed UNTRACKED (git ls-files --error-unmatch returned nothing for all four; the tree is covered by .gitignore:81 /web/results/) — the same pre-rm check d83f7a8's disposal used.
disposed.why_it_was_safe: the live products carry the content. Re-verified immediately before the rm, not taken from the earlier run: full sha256 of each live FITS equals the sha measured post-rebuild in the P1 comparison (5242429f… / 78e9b123… / 500f7b35…, each recorded PIXEL-IDENTICAL at 0 differing of 53,164,470 values), and the live judge surface set-01_full_spcc-linked.png is BYTE-IDENTICAL to the approved copy that was deleted (1133b658c0dfdb45…, 96,955,822 B) — so the owner's standing approval of that surface still rests on a file that is on disk.
disposed.disk: 734,967,982 B removed (du -cb before the rm). `df -h` reads 638G before and after — that is ROUNDING at GB granularity, not a failed delete; the four paths are gone and the directory is rmdir'd.
disposed.what_this_does_not_do: it does not re-open anything about the product's QUALITY. This unit established the product is REPRODUCIBLE, not good: it still carries REGMODEL=starpair / REGUNDIS=False, and datasets/aug06/corner_work/corner_quality.json measures set-01 at roundness 0.939 -> 0.569 across rho 0.03-0.80. Per-set attribution for that band is UNSETTLED — the record predates the union-scoped closure of BACKLOG:compose-homography-smear and nothing extends that closure to the per-set products.
